data.name: OpenAPI Compatibility Reviewer
data.description: Reviews OpenAPI changes for backward compatibility and response contract drift.
data.contentMarkdown:
# OpenAPI Compatibility Reviewer

You specialize in reviewing OpenAPI changes for compatibility.

## Focus Areas

- Removed paths or operations
- Changed HTTP methods
- New required request fields
- Removed or renamed response fields
- Status code behavior changes
- Authentication or authorization changes
- Pagination, filtering, and sorting contract changes

## Review Rules

Treat removed or renamed fields as breaking unless a migration path is documented.
Treat new required request fields as breaking for existing consumers.
Treat additive optional response fields as usually compatible.

## Output Format

Use this format:

- Compatibility verdict: Compatible, Possibly Breaking, or Breaking
- Breaking changes
- Non-breaking changes
- Questions for the API owner
- Suggested migration notes

This gives you a good manual verification path: create parent, create child using the parent dropdown, open Skill Workspace, confirm categories/tags render as labels, then edit the skill and confirm parent/taxonomy values preselect correctly.

data.configDesc: The configuration for pathService.yml used by com.networknt.router.middleware.PathServiceHandler. When using router, each request must have serviceId in the header in order to allow router to do the service discovery before invoke downstream service. The reason we have to do that is due to the unpredictable path between services. If you are sure that all the downstream services can be identified by the path, then you can use this Path to ServiceId mapper handler to uniquely identify the serviceId and put it into the header. In this case, the client can invoke the service just the same way it is invoking the service directly. Please note that you cannot invoke /health or /server/info endpoints as these are the common endpoints injected by the framework and all services will have them on the same path. The router cannot figure out which service you want to invoke so an error message will be returned This handler depends on OpenAPIHandler or SwaggerHandler in light-rest-4j framework. That means this handler only works with RESTful APIs. In rest swagger-meta or openapi-meta, the endpoint of each request is saved into auditInfo object which is attached to the exchange for auditing. This service mapper handler is very similar to the ServiceDictHandler but this one is using the light-rest-4j endpoint in the auditInfo object to do the mapping and the other one is doing the path and method pattern to do the mapping.

data.spec:
---
openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: "Swagger Petstore"
  license:
    name: "MIT"
servers:
- url: "http://petstore.swagger.io/v1"
paths:
  /pets:
    get:
      summary: "List all pets"
      operationId: "listPets"
      tags:
      - "pets"
      parameters:
      - name: "limit"
        in: "query"
        description: "How many items to return at one time (max 100)"
        required: false
        schema:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int32"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "An paged array of pets"
          headers:
            x-next:
              description: "A link to the next page of responses"
              schema:
                type: "string"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: "array"
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
              example:
              - id: 1
                name: "catten"
                tag: "cat"
              - id: 2
                name: "doggy"
                tag: "dog"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    post:
      summary: "Create a pet"
      operationId: "createPets"
      requestBody:
        description: "Pet to add to the store"
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
      tags:
      - "pets"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
        - "write:pets"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: "Null response"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /pets/{petId}:
    get:
      summary: "Info for a specific pet"
      operationId: "showPetById"
      tags:
      - "pets"
      parameters:
      - name: "petId"
        in: "path"
        required: true
        description: "The id of the pet to retrieve"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Expected response to a valid request"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
              example:
                id: 1
                name: "Jessica Right"
                tag: "pet"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    put:
      summary: "Update a pet"
      operationId: "updatePets"
      parameters:
      - name: "petId"
        in: "path"
        required: true
        description: "The id of the pet to update"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      requestBody:
        description: "Pet to update"
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UpdatePet"
      tags:
      - "pets"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
        - "write:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Successfully updated pets"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    delete:
      summary: "Delete a specific pet"
      operationId: "deletePetById"
      tags:
      - "pets"
      parameters:
      - name: "petId"
        in: "path"
        required: true
        description: "The id of the pet to delete"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      - name: "key"
        in: "header"
        required: true
        description: "The key header"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "write:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Expected response to a valid request"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Pet"
              examples:
                response:
                  value:
                    id: 1
                    name: "Jessica Right"
                    tag: "pet"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /accounts:
    get:
      summary: "Get a list of accounts"
      operationId: "getAccounts"
      tags:
      - "accounts"
      parameters:
      - name: "limit"
        in: "query"
        description: "How many items to return at one time (max 100)"
        required: false
        schema:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int32"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "An paged array of accounts"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: "array"
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account"
              example:
              - accountNo: 123
                ownerId: "johndoe"
                accountType: "P"
                firstName: "John"
                lastName: "Doe"
                status: "O"
              - id: 2
                accountNo: 456
                ownerId: "johndoe"
                accountType: "B"
                firstName: "John"
                lastName: "Doe"
                status: "C"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    post:
      summary: "Create an account"
      operationId: "createAccount"
      requestBody:
        description: "Account to add to the system"
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account"
      tags:
      - "accounts"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
        - "write:pets"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: "Null response"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /accounts/{accountNo}:
    get:
      summary: "get account with a specific accountNo"
      operationId: "getAccountByNo"
      tags:
      - "accounts"
      parameters:
      - name: "accountNo"
        in: "path"
        required: true
        description: "The accountNo of the account to retrieve"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Expected response to a valid request"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account"
              example:
                accountNo: 123
                ownerId: "johndoe"
                accountType: "P"
                firstName: "John"
                lastName: "Doe"
                status: "O"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    put:
      summary: "Update an account by accountNo"
      operationId: "updateAccountByNo"
      parameters:
      - name: "accountNo"
        in: "path"
        required: true
        description: "The account no of the account to update"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      requestBody:
        description: "Account to update"
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account"
      tags:
      - "accounts"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
        - "write:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Successfully updated accounts"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
    delete:
      summary: "Delete a specific account by accountNo"
      operationId: "deleteAccountByNo"
      tags:
      - "accounts"
      parameters:
      - name: "accountNo"
        in: "path"
        required: true
        description: "The no of the account to delete"
        schema:
          type: "string"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "write:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Expected response to a valid request"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Account"
              examples:
                response:
                  value:
                    accountNo: 123
                    ownerId: "johndoe"
                    accountType: "P"
                    firstName: "John"
                    lastName: "Doe"
                    status: "O"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /notifications:
    get:
      summary: "Get Notifications"
      operationId: "listNotifications"
      tags:
      - "notifications"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "A standard notification response in JSON for response interceptor\
            \ test"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /flowers:
    post:
      summary: "The API accept XML and the consumer is using JSON"
      operationId: "flowers"
      tags:
      - "flowers"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Return an flowers XML as the demo soap service"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /documents:
    get:
      summary: "The API to get a document in a JSON with base64 content"
      operationId: "documents"
      tags:
      - "documents"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Return a document with base64 content in JSON format"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
  /streams:
    get:
      summary: "The API to get a stream of json response"
      operationId: "streams"
      tags:
      - "streams"
      security:
      - petstore_auth:
        - "read:pets"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: "Return a stream with json content in JSON format"
        default:
          description: "unexpected error"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Error"
components:
  securitySchemes:
    petstore_auth:
      type: "oauth2"
      description: "This API uses OAuth 2 with the client credential grant flow."
      flows:
        clientCredentials:
          tokenUrl: "https://localhost:6882/token"
          scopes:
            write:pets: "modify pets in your account"
            read:pets: "read your pets"
  schemas:
    Pet:
      allOf:
      - $ref: "#/components/schemas/NewPet"
      - type: "object"
        required:
        - "id"
        properties:
          id:
            type: "integer"
            format: "int64"
    NewPet:
      type: "object"
      required:
      - "name"
      properties:
        name:
          type: "string"
        tag:
          type: "string"
    UpdatePet:
      type: "object"
      properties:
        petAge:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/petAge"
        petToys:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/petToys"
        ownerEmail:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ownerEmail"
        ownerSsn:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ownerSsn"
      additionalProperties: false
    petAge:
      maximum: 20
      minimum: 1
      type: "integer"
      description: "current age of the pet"
      nullable: false
    petToys:
      type: "array"
      description: "Toys of the pet"
      items:
        type: "string"
    ownerEmail:
      maxLength: 65
      minLength: 2
      pattern: "^[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Z]{2,6}$"
      type: "string"
      description: "owner email"
    ownerSsn:
      pattern: "^\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}$"
      type: "string"
      description: "owner SSN"
    Account:
      type: "object"
      required:
      - "accountNo"
      - "userId"
      - "accountType"
      - "status"
      properties:
        accountNo:
          type: "string"
        userId:
          type: "string"
        accountType:
          type: "string"
        firstName:
          type: "string"
        lastName:
          type: "string"
        status:
          type: "string"
    Error:
      type: "object"
      required:
      - "code"
      - "message"
      properties:
        code:
          type: "integer"
          format: "int32"
        message:
          type: "string"

document:
  dsl: "1.0.3"
  namespace: light-portal
  name: human-approval
  version: "1.0.1"
  title: Human Approval
  summary: Creates an ask task that waits for an operator approval decision.
  tags:
    testType: local
    dependencies: worklist
input:
  schema:
    format: json
    document:
      type: object
      properties:
        requestId:
          type: string
        summary:
          type: string
      required:
        - requestId
        - summary
do:
  - requestApproval:
      ask:
        prompt: Review the workflow request and choose a decision.
        mode: approval

data.name: personalized-offer-rest-v1
data.definition:
document:
  dsl: "1.0.3"
  namespace: light-demo
  name: personalized-offer-rest-v1
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Personalized Offer via REST Workflow
  summary: Calls the demo customer profile and offer decision APIs directly and returns a normalized offer decision.
  tags:
    demo: skill-workflow-orchestration
    executionPath: rest
input:
  schema:
    format: json
    document:
      type: object
      required:
        - customerId
        - channel
      properties:
        customerId:
          type: string
          example: CUST-1001
        channel:
          type: string
          default: portal
          example: portal
output:
  schema:
    format: json
    document:
      type: object
      required:
        - status
        - customerId
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - APPROVED
            - REJECTED
            - NO_CONSENT
            - NO_ELIGIBLE_OFFER
        customerId:
          type: string
        selectedOfferId:
          type: string
        decisionId:
          type: string
        reason:
          type: string
do:
  - loadProfile:
      call: http
      with:
        method: GET
        endpoint:
          uri: http://demo-customer-profile-api:8085/customers/${ .customerId }
        output: content
      export:
        as:
          profile: .output
  - loadPreferences:
      call: http
      with:
        method: GET
        endpoint:
          uri: http://demo-customer-profile-api:8085/customers/${ .customerId }/preferences?channel=${ .channel }
        output: content
      export:
        as:
          preferences: .output
  - checkConsent:
      switch:
        - noConsent:
            when: .preferences.consent == false
            then: noConsentResult
        - default:
            then: searchOffers
  - noConsentResult:
      set:
        status: NO_CONSENT
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        reason: Customer has not consented to personalized offers.
      end: true
  - searchOffers:
      call: http
      with:
        method: GET
        endpoint:
          uri: http://demo-offer-decision-api:8086/offers?segment=${ .profile.segment }&state=${ .profile.state }&category=travel
        output: content
      export:
        as:
          offers: .output
  - evaluateEligibility:
      switch:
        - premiumOntario:
            when: .profile.segment == premium
            then: selectOffer
        - default:
            then: noEligibleOfferResult
  - noEligibleOfferResult:
      set:
        status: NO_ELIGIBLE_OFFER
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        reason: No active offer matches the customer profile and preferences.
      end: true
  - selectOffer:
      set:
        offerId: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
        reason: Selected highest-priority travel offer for the premium Ontario demo segment.
      export:
        as:
          selectedOffer: .output
  - requestApproval:
      ask:
        prompt: Review the selected personalized offer decision.
        mode: approval
        assignment:
          roleId: admin
          categoryCode: approval
          reasonCode: personalized-offer-rest
        options:
          - label: Approve
            value: APPROVED
            description: Record the selected offer decision.
          - label: Reject
            value: REJECTED
            description: Stop without recording an offer decision.
        required: true
        timeout:
          after: PT24H
        onTimeout:
          action: default
          default: REJECTED
      export:
        as:
          approval: .output
      then: checkApproval
  - checkApproval:
      switch:
        - rejected:
            when: .approval.value == REJECTED
            then: rejectedResult
        - default:
            then: recordDecision
  - rejectedResult:
      set:
        status: REJECTED
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        selectedOfferId: "${ .selectedOffer.offerId }"
        reason: Offer decision was rejected by the assigned approver.
      end: true
  - recordDecision:
      call: http
      with:
        method: POST
        endpoint:
          uri: http://demo-offer-decision-api:8086/offer-decisions
        body:
          customerId: "${ .customerId }"
          offerId: "${ .selectedOffer.offerId }"
          channel: "${ .channel }"
          source: workflow-rest
          reason: "${ .selectedOffer.reason }"
          idempotencyKey: "personalized-offer-rest-v1:${ .customerId }:${ .selectedOffer.offerId }"
        output: content
      export:
        as:
          decision: .output
  - finish:
      set:
        status: APPROVED
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        selectedOfferId: "${ .decision.offerId }"
        decisionId: "${ .decision.decisionId }"
      end: true

When overwriting a value, the key must be specified in order to identify the right header. If only the oldK and newK are specified, the router will rewrite the header key oldK with different key newK and keep the value. The format of the rule will be a map with the path as the key. data.spec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Demo Offer Decision API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Offer search and offer decision API for the Light Fabric workflow demo.
servers:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:8086
    description: Local development
  - url: http://demo-offer-decision-api:8086
    description: Demo service discovery name
tags:
  - name: Health
  - name: Offers
  - name: Offer Decisions
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags:
        - Health
      operationId: getOfferDecisionHealth
      summary: Get service health
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Service health status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthResponse"
              examples:
                healthy:
                  value:
                    status: UP
                    service: demo-offer-decision-api
  /offers:
    get:
      tags:
        - Offers
      operationId: searchOffers
      summary: Search active offers
      parameters:
        - name: segment
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Customer segment filter.
          schema:
            type: string
          example: premium
        - name: state
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Region or province filter.
          schema:
            type: string
          example: ON
        - name: category
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Offer category filter.
          schema:
            type: string
          example: travel
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Active offers matching the supplied filters, sorted by priority.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Offer"
              examples:
                travelOffers:
                  value:
                    - offerId: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
                      title: Premium travel credit
                      segment: premium
                      state: ON
                      category: travel
                      priority: 1
                      active: true
  /offer-decisions:
    post:
      tags:
        - Offer Decisions
      operationId: recordOfferDecision
      summary: Record an offer decision
      parameters:
        - name: idempotency-key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the service derives one from customer, offer, and channel.
          schema:
            type: string
          example: wf-demo-1001
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/OfferDecisionRequest"
            examples:
              workflowDecision:
                value:
                  customerId: CUST-1001
                  offerId: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
                  channel: portal
                  source: workflow
                  reason: demo
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Recorded offer decision.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/OfferDecisionResponse"
              examples:
                approved:
                  value:
                    decisionId: DEC-1001
                    customerId: CUST-1001
                    offerId: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
                    decision: approved
                    createdAt: "2026-05-25T14:12:00Z"
                    auditRef: AUD-WORKFLOW
        "400":
          description: The requested offer is inactive or does not exist.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                inactiveOffer:
                  value:
                    code: INVALID_DECISION_REQUEST
                    message: offer OFFER-EXPIRED-01 is not active or does not exist
components:
  schemas:
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - status
        - service
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          example: UP
        service:
          type: string
          example: demo-offer-decision-api
    Offer:
      type: object
      required:
        - offerId
        - title
        - segment
        - state
        - category
        - priority
        - active
      properties:
        offerId:
          type: string
          example: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
        title:
          type: string
          example: Premium travel credit
        segment:
          type: string
          example: premium
        state:
          type: string
          example: ON
        category:
          type: string
          example: travel
        priority:
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 255
          example: 1
        active:
          type: boolean
          example: true
    OfferDecisionRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - customerId
        - offerId
        - channel
        - source
        - reason
      properties:
        customerId:
          type: string
          example: CUST-1001
        offerId:
          type: string
          example: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
        channel:
          type: string
          example: portal
        source:
          type: string
          example: workflow
        reason:
          type: string
          example: demo
        idempotencyKey:
          type: string
          nullable: true
          description: Optional idempotency key in the JSON body.
          example: wf-demo-1001
    OfferDecisionResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - decisionId
        - customerId
        - offerId
        - decision
        - createdAt
        - auditRef
      properties:
        decisionId:
          type: string
          example: DEC-1001
        customerId:
          type: string
          example: CUST-1001
        offerId:
          type: string
          example: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
        decision:
          type: string
          example: approved
        createdAt:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: "2026-05-25T14:12:00Z"

data.configDesc: The audit.yml configuration and used by com.networknt.audit.AuditHandler. The audit handler dumps most important info per-request basis. This handler can be used on production but be aware that it will impact the overall performance. Turning off statusCode and responseTime can make it faster as these have to be captured on the response chain instead of request chain. For most business and the majority of microservices, you don't need to enable this handler due to performance reason. The default audit log will be the audit.log configured in the default logback.xml; however, it can be changed to syslog or Kafka with customized appender. The audit.yml can control which fields should be included in the final log. By default, the following fields are included: timestamp, serviceId (from server.yml), correlationId, traceabilityId (if available), clientId, userId (if available), scopeClientId (available if called by another API), endpoint (uriPattern@method), statusCode, responseTime.

When LightProxyHandler is used in the http-sidecar or light-gateway, it can collect the metrics info for the total response time of the downstream API. With this value injected, users can quickly determine how much time the http-sidecar or light-gateway handlers spend and how much time the downstream API spends, including the network latency. By default, it is false, and metrics will not be collected and injected into the metrics handler configured in the request/response chain.

When light-gateway or http-sidecar is used for security, sometimes, we need to pass some claims from the JWT or SWT to the backend API for further verification or audit. You can select some claims to pass to the backend API with HTTP headers. The format is a map of claim in the token and a header name that the downstream API is expecting. You can use both JSON or YAML format.
When SwtVerifyHandler is used, the claim names are in https://github.com/networknt/light-4j/blob/master/client/src/main/java/com/networknt/client/oauth/TokenInfo.java
When JwtVerifyHandler is used, the claim names is the JwtClaims claimName.

data.name: simple-set-assert
data.definition:
document:
  dsl: "1.0.3"
  namespace: light-portal
  name: simple-set-assert
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Simple Set and Assert
  summary: Local smoke test for set, export, assert, and sequential transitions.
  tags:
    testType: local
    dependencies: none
input:
  schema:
    format: json
    document:
      type: object
      properties:
        applicantId:
          type: string
      required:
        - applicantId
do:
  - initializeDecision:
      set:
        applicantId: "${ .applicantId }"
        status: APPROVED
        reason: Local set task completed
      export:
        as:
          decision: .output
  - verifyDecision:
      assert:
        value: "${ .decision.status }"
        equals: APPROVED
      export:
        as:
          verification: .output
  - finish:
      set:
        applicantId: "${ .decision.applicantId }"
        status: "${ .decision.status }"
        verified: "${ .verification.passed }"

data.description: Reviews API definitions for governance, naming, security, and compatibility issues.
data.contentMarkdown:
# API Governance Reviewer

You are an API governance reviewer for Light Portal.

## Goal

Review an API, workflow, or agent-facing contract and identify issues that could affect maintainability, compatibility, security, or developer experience.

## Review Checklist

- Confirm names are clear, stable, and domain-specific.
- Check whether descriptions explain business purpose, not only implementation details.
- Identify missing ownership, versioning, or lifecycle metadata.
- Look for security-sensitive inputs, outputs, headers, tokens, or identifiers.
- Flag compatibility risks such as renamed fields, removed fields, changed required fields, or response shape drift.
- Suggest focused improvements without rewriting unrelated parts.

## Output Format

Return the result as:

1. Summary
2. Findings
3. Recommended changes
4. Residual risks

Keep findings concise and actionable.

data.configDesc: The configuration for salesforce.yml used by com.networknt.proxy.salesforce.SalesforceHandler which is a customized handler for authentication and authorization with cloud Salesforce service within an enterprise environment. It is converted from a customized flow for the business logic. For any external Salesforce request, this handler will check if there is a cached salesforce token that is not expired. If true, put the token into the header. If false, get a new token by following the flow and put it into the header and cache it. The way to get a salesforce token is to sign a token with your private key and salesforce will have the public key to verify your token. Send a request with grant_type and assertion as body to the url defined in the config file. Salesforce will issue an access token for API access. For the token caching, we only cache the salesforce token. The jwt token we created only last 5 minutes, and it is not cached.

A flag to indicate if the caller id will be sent as a common tag. If it is true, try to retrieve it from the audit info and send it if it is not null. If it doesn't exist, "unknown" will be sent. By default, this tag is not sent regardless if it is in the audit info. The purpose of this tag is similar to the scopeClientId to identify the immediate caller service in a microservice application. As the scopeClientId is only available when the scope token is used, it cannot be used for all apps. light-4j client module has a config to enforce all services to send the callerId to the downstream API, and it can be enforced within an organization. In most cases, this callerId is more reliable.

Method rewrite rules for legacy clients that do not support DELETE, PUT, and PATCH HTTP methods to send a request with GET and POST instead. The gateway will rewrite the method from GET to DELETE or from POST to PUT or PATCH. This will be set up at the endpoint level to limit the application. The format of the rule will be endpoint-pattern source-method target-method. The endpoint-pattern is a pattern in OpenAPI specification. Example: [/v2/address POST PUT, /v1/address POST PATCH] Note: you cannot rewrite a method with a body to a method without a body or vice versa.

data.name: personalized-offer-mcp-v1
data.definition:
document:
  dsl: "1.0.3"
  namespace: light-demo
  name: personalized-offer-mcp-v1
  version: "1.0.0"
  title: Personalized Offer via MCP Router
  summary: Calls the demo customer profile and offer decision APIs through light-gateway MCP tools and returns a normalized offer decision.
  tags:
    demo: skill-workflow-orchestration
    executionPath: mcp
input:
  schema:
    format: json
    document:
      type: object
      required:
        - customerId
        - channel
      properties:
        customerId:
          type: string
          example: CUST-1001
        channel:
          type: string
          default: portal
          example: portal
output:
  schema:
    format: json
    document:
      type: object
      required:
        - status
        - customerId
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - APPROVED
            - REJECTED
            - NO_CONSENT
            - NO_ELIGIBLE_OFFER
        customerId:
          type: string
        selectedOfferId:
          type: string
        decisionId:
          type: string
        reason:
          type: string
use:
  mcpSessions:
    gateway:
      server:
        endpoint:
          uri: https://light-gateway:8443/mcp
        transport: http
      reuse: true
do:
  - loadProfile:
      call: mcp
      with:
        session: gateway
        tool: getCustomerProfile
        arguments:
          customerId: "${ .customerId }"
      export:
        as:
          profile: .output.structuredContent
  - loadPreferences:
      call: mcp
      with:
        session: gateway
        tool: getCustomerPreferences
        arguments:
          customerId: "${ .customerId }"
          channel: "${ .channel }"
      export:
        as:
          preferences: .output.structuredContent
  - checkConsent:
      switch:
        - noConsent:
            when: .preferences.consent == false
            then: noConsentResult
        - default:
            then: searchOffers
  - noConsentResult:
      set:
        status: NO_CONSENT
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        reason: Customer has not consented to personalized offers.
      end: true
  - searchOffers:
      call: mcp
      with:
        session: gateway
        tool: searchOffers
        arguments:
          segment: "${ .profile.segment }"
          state: "${ .profile.state }"
          category: travel
      export:
        as:
          offers: .output.structuredContent
  - evaluateEligibility:
      switch:
        - premiumOntario:
            when: .profile.segment == premium
            then: selectOffer
        - default:
            then: noEligibleOfferResult
  - noEligibleOfferResult:
      set:
        status: NO_ELIGIBLE_OFFER
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        reason: No active offer matches the customer profile and preferences.
      end: true
  - selectOffer:
      set:
        offerId: OFFER-TRAVEL-01
        reason: Selected highest-priority travel offer for the premium Ontario demo segment.
      export:
        as:
          selectedOffer: .output
  - requestApproval:
      ask:
        prompt: Review the selected personalized offer decision.
        mode: approval
        assignment:
          roleId: admin
          categoryCode: approval
          reasonCode: personalized-offer-mcp
        options:
          - label: Approve
            value: APPROVED
            description: Record the selected offer decision.
          - label: Reject
            value: REJECTED
            description: Stop without recording an offer decision.
        required: true
        timeout:
          after: PT24H
        onTimeout:
          action: default
          default: REJECTED
      export:
        as:
          approval: .output
      then: checkApproval
  - checkApproval:
      switch:
        - rejected:
            when: .approval.value == REJECTED
            then: rejectedResult
        - default:
            then: recordDecision
  - rejectedResult:
      set:
        status: REJECTED
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        selectedOfferId: "${ .selectedOffer.offerId }"
        reason: Offer decision was rejected by the assigned approver.
      end: true
  - recordDecision:
      call: mcp
      with:
        session: gateway
        tool: recordOfferDecision
        arguments:
          customerId: "${ .customerId }"
          offerId: "${ .selectedOffer.offerId }"
          channel: "${ .channel }"
          source: workflow-mcp
          reason: "${ .selectedOffer.reason }"
          idempotencyKey: "personalized-offer-mcp-v1:${ .customerId }:${ .selectedOffer.offerId }"
      export:
        as:
          decision: .output.structuredContent
  - finish:
      set:
        status: APPROVED
        customerId: "${ .customerId }"
        selectedOfferId: "${ .decision.offerId }"
        decisionId: "${ .decision.decisionId }"
      end: true

data.definition:
document:
  dsl: '1.0.3'
  namespace: financial.services
  name: mortgage-approval-process
  version: '1.0.0'
input:
  schema:
    type: object
    properties:
      applicantId: { type: string }
      loanAmount: { type: number }
      creditScore: { type: number }
do:
  - evaluateRisk:
      call: http
      with:
        method: post
        endpoint: 
          uri: "http://risk-engine.internal/evaluate"
        body: 
          applicantId: "${{ .applicantId }}"
          score: "${{ .creditScore }}"
          amount: "${{ .loanAmount }}"
      export:
        evaluation: ".output"
  - riskBranching:
      switch:
        - if: "${{ .evaluation.riskScore < 30 }}"
          then: autoApprove
        - if: "${{ .evaluation.riskScore > 80 }}"
          then: autoReject
      default: manualApproval
  - autoApprove:
      set:
        status: "APPROVED"
        decisionSource: "Automatic"
        message: "Loan approved automatically based on low risk score."
      end: true
  - autoReject:
      set:
        status: "REJECTED"
        decisionSource: "Automatic"
        message: "Loan rejected automatically due to high risk score."
      end: true
  - manualApproval:
      listen:
        to:
          one:
            with:
              type: "mortgage.manual.decision"
        timeout:
          after: "PT24H"
      export:
        manualStatus: ".output.status"
        comment: ".output.comment"
      then: finalizeDecision
  - finalizeDecision:
      set:
        status: "${{ .manualStatus }}"
        decisionSource: "Human"
        message: "${{ .comment }}"
      end: true

data.configDesc: The ApiKey Authentication Security Configuration for light-4j present in apikey.yml and used by com.networknt.apikey.ApiKeyHandler. For some legacy applications to migrate from the monolithic gateway to light-gateway without changing any code, we need to support the API Key authentication on the light-gateway(LG) or light-client-proxy(LCP) to authenticate the consumer and then change the authentication from API Key to OAuth 2.0 for downstream API access. Only certain paths will have API Key set up and the header name for each application might be different. To support all use cases, we add a list of maps to the configuration apikey.yml to pathPrefixAuths property. Each config item will have pathPrefix, headerName and apiKey. The handler will try to match the path prefix first and then get the input API Key from the header. After compare with the configured API Key, the handler will return either ERR10057 API_KEY_MISMATCH or pass the control to the next handler in the chain.

data.spec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Demo Customer Profile API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Customer profile and preference lookup API for the Light Fabric workflow demo.
servers:
  - url: http://127.0.0.1:8085
    description: Local development
  - url: http://demo-customer-profile-api:8085
    description: Demo service discovery name
tags:
  - name: Health
  - name: Customers
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags:
        - Health
      operationId: getCustomerProfileHealth
      summary: Get service health
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Service health status.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/HealthResponse"
              examples:
                healthy:
                  value:
                    status: UP
                    service: demo-customer-profile-api
  /customers/{customerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - Customers
      operationId: getCustomerProfile
      summary: Get a customer profile
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/CustomerId"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Customer profile.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/CustomerProfile"
              examples:
                premiumCustomer:
                  value:
                    customerId: CUST-1001
                    displayName: Avery Chen
                    segment: premium
                    state: ON
                    accountStatus: active
        "404":
          description: Customer was not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                customerNotFound:
                  value:
                    code: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND
                    message: customer CUST-9999 was not found
  /customers/{customerId}/preferences:
    get:
      tags:
        - Customers
      operationId: getCustomerPreferences
      summary: Get customer preferences
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/CustomerId"
        - name: channel
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Requested channel context. Defaults to portal when omitted.
          schema:
            type: string
            default: portal
          example: portal
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Customer preferences for the requested channel.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/PreferencesResponse"
              examples:
                portalPreferences:
                  value:
                    customerId: CUST-1001
                    channel: portal
                    consent: true
                    preferredCategories:
                      - travel
                    preferredContactChannel: portal
        "404":
          description: Customer was not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                customerNotFound:
                  value:
                    code: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND
                    message: customer CUST-9999 was not found
components:
  parameters:
    CustomerId:
      name: customerId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: Customer identifier.
      schema:
        type: string
      example: CUST-1001
  schemas:
    HealthResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - status
        - service
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
          example: UP
        service:
          type: string
          example: demo-customer-profile-api
    CustomerProfile:
      type: object
      required:
        - customerId
        - displayName
        - segment
        - state
        - accountStatus
      properties:
        customerId:
          type: string
          example: CUST-1001
        displayName:
          type: string
          example: Avery Chen
        segment:
          type: string
          example: premium
        state:
          type: string
          example: ON
        accountStatus:
          type: string
          example: active
    PreferencesResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - customerId
        - channel
        - consent
        - preferredCategories
        - preferredContactChannel
      properties:
        customerId:
          type: string
          example: CUST-1001
        channel:
          type: string
          example: portal
        consent:
          type: boolean
          example: true
        preferredCategories:
          type: array
          items:
            type: string
          example:
            - travel
        preferredContactChannel:
          type: string
          example: portal
    ErrorResponse:
      type: object
      required:
        - code
        - message
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          example: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND
        message:
          type: string
          example: customer CUST-9999 was not found

The client.yml must be set to true for multipleAuthServers and the token will be verified on the same LPC.

If a particular downstream service has different timeout than the above global definition, you can add the path prefix and give it another timeout in millisecond. For downstream APIs not defined here, they will use the global timeout defined in router.maxRequestTime. The value is a map with key is the path prefix and value is the timeout. Example: {/v1/address: 5000, /v2/address: 10000, /v3/address: 30000, /v1/pets/{petId}: 5000}

data.configDesc: This configuration is for access control provided by openapi module for handler com.networknt.openapi.AccessControlHandler. This is a business middleware handler that should be put after the technical middleware handlers in the request/response chain. It handles fine-grained authorization on the business domain. In the request chain, it will check a list of conditions (rule-based authorization) at the endpoint level. In the response chain, a list of rules/conditions will be checked to filter the response to remove some rows and/or some columns. This handler is depending on the yaml-rule from light-4j of networknt and all rules for the service will be loaded during the startup time with a startup hook and this handler will use the cached rules and data to do local calculation for the best performance.

data.configDesc: The configuration for health.yml used by com.networknt.health.HealthGetHandler which has a Server health endpoint that can output OK to indicate the server is alive. Normally, it will be use by F5 to check if the server is health before route request to it. Another way to check server health is to ping the ip and port and it is the standard way to check server status for F5. However, the service instance is up and running doesn't mean it is functioning. This is the reason to provide a this handler to output more information about the server for F5 or maybe in the future for the API marketplace. Note that we only recommend to use F5 as reverse proxy for services with static IP addresses that act like traditional web server. These services will be sitting in DMZ to serve mobile native and browser SPA and aggregate other services in the backend. For services deployed in the cloud dynamically, there is no reverse proxy but using client side service discovery.

Query parameter rewrite rules for client applications that send different query parameter keys or values than the target server expecting. When overwriting a value, the key must be specified in order to identify the right query parameter. If only the oldK and newK are specified, the router will rewrite the query parameter key oldK with different key newK and keep the value. The format of the rules will be a map with the path as the key. You can define a list of rules under the same path. Example: {/v1/address: [{oldK: oldV, newK: newV}], /v1/pets/{petId}: [{oldK: oldV, newK: newV},{oldK: oldV2, newK: newV2}]}
